an3.82:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gadrabho gogaṇaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddho hoti
an3.82:1.2: aham pi amhā aham pi amhā ti.
an3.82:1.3: Tassa na tādiso vaṇṇo hoti seyyathāpi gunnaṃ, na tādiso saro hoti seyyathāpi gunnaṃ, na tādisaṃ padaṃ hoti seyyathāpi gunnaṃ.
an3.82:1.4: So gogaṇaṃ yeva piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddho hoti
an3.82:1.5: aham pi amhā aham pi amhā ti. Evam
an3.82:2.1: eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhikkhu bhikkhusaṅghaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddho hoti,
an3.82:2.2: aham pi bhikkhu aham pi bhikkhū ti.
an3.82:2.3: Tassa na tādiso chando hoti adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, na tādiso chando hoti adhicittasikkhāsamādāne seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, na tādiso chando hoti adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ.
an3.82:2.4: So bhikkhusaṅghaṃ yeva piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddho hoti
an3.82:2.5: aham pi bhikkhu aham pi bhikkhū ti.
an3.82:3.2: tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne ti. Evaṃ
